test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. 2,400 is invested for 4 years at R% p.a, simple interest and the simple interest received is Rs. 1,152. Find the amount received after 3 years when the same sum is invested at (R + 8) % p.a, simple interest.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 2400

Time = 4 years

SI = Rs. 1152

**Concept Used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where, P = Principal

R = Rate

T = Time

SI = Simple Interest

**Calculation:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 1152 = (2400 × R × 4)/100

⇒ R = (1152 × 100)/(2400 × 4)

⇒ R = 12%

New R = (12 + 8) = 20%

New T = 3 years

SI = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ (2400 × 20 × 3)/100

⇒ 1440

Amount = P + SI

⇒ 2400 + 1440

⇒ Rs. 3840

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
